script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
aws s3 cp s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/inputs/vllm-single-development-02.tar.gz /tmp/karpo-vllm-development-02.tar.gz --region us-east-1 --no-progress
printf '%s  %s\n' 'e2cc463e99ea85552d82f9f9bae1765d65d05bbb7fe2bf6686cd4c5960e89191' /tmp/karpo-vllm-development-02.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /tmp/karpo-vllm-development-02.tar.gz -C /opt/karpo
aws s3 cp /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/setup/ s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-single-20261120/setup/ --recursive --region us-east-1 --no-progress
aws s3 cp /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/encoding/ s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-single-20261120/encoding/ --recursive --region us-east-1 --no-progress
/opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python /opt/karpo/tests/test_vllm_karpo.py > /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/setup/adapter-tests.log 2>&1
mkdir -p /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-01
systemd-run --unit=karpo-vllm-development-01 --property=RuntimeMaxSec=1800 --property=StandardOutput=append:/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-01/server.log --property=StandardError=inherit --setenv=OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 --setenv=TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false --setenv=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 /opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python /opt/karpo/scripts/vllm_karpo_server.py --checkpoint /opt/karpo/models/karpo-4b --output /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-01 --max-seqs 1
